plainText:
Silver's Ursaring (Japanese: シルバーのリングマ Silver's Ringuma) is a that owns in Pokémon Adventures and his seventh overall. In the , he was given to . As of The Last Battle XIV, he is at level 44.

==History==
=== ===
 
Ursaring first appeared in Teddiursa's Picnic, attacking and Maizie as they approached a wild . Ursaring chases the two and they soon run into . Realizing that Silver is planning on capturing Ursaring, Gold decides to catch him as well. Gold sends Aibo out to attack Ursaring and he starts unleashing multiple es on him. Silver quickly joins in and tells and to attack Ursaring as well, irritating the Hibernator Pokémon. Ursaring then aims a at Maizie and Gold saves her just in time. Ursaring attempts another Slash and jumps in and uses to freeze his paws, though he manages to thaw them with . Ursaring and Teddiursa soon corner the group on a cliff. While the situation looked hopeless, Silver taught Gold the proper way to a Pokémon, and the two managed to catch Ursaring and Teddiursa. Afterwards, Silver uses Ursaring to defeat the disturbing the at Slowpoke Well.

In Tyranitar War, Ursaring participated in Silver's fight against Gold, going up against his Sudobo. Ursaring attacked with a barrage of , while Sudobo countered it with . After a quick show of strength, with Ursaring coming out on top, he is recalled in favor of .

In Sandslash Surprise, Ursaring and the rest of Silver's team helped defeat a group of .

In The Last Battle XI, Ursaring and Silver's other Pokémon defeated Will by attacking with Sneasel's .
 
=== ===
 
In Storming the Forretress, Silver gave Ursaring to his father, , so Ursaring could take him to one of Silver's secret hideouts to recover.

=== ===
Sometime before the start of the arc, Giovanni and Ursaring were in Ilex Forest waiting for to appear. Celebi eventually came and brought Pryce along with it, whom Ursaring immediately began attacking. Before he could cause any major damage, though, Lance showed up and stopped them, informing the group that they all shared a common goal.

In All About Arceus V, Ursaring shows up alongside Giovanni to help with the crisis. Upon arriving, he ruthlessly brushed Petrel aside after he attempts to disguise himself as Giovanni. Soon after, he battled and attacks with a powerful Slash. Later, during the battle, Ursaring threw his opponent around and used , dealing heavy damage.
 

==Personality and characteristics==
Typical of his species, Ursaring seems to be aggressive and hostile toward everyone. Ursaring was also an extremely powerful battler, being the powerhouse of 's team when he was with him, and he was even recognized by for his strength. Ursaring has a lot of pride, as he refused to be captured by an average .

==Moves used==
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Trivia==
Ursaring is currently Silver's only Pokémon to be kept inside a Poké Ball variant.
Ursaring is the only Pokémon belonging to Silver that has not reached his final form.
Ursaring is the only Pokémon in Pokémon Adventures to have used the move .
